claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_on_hit_charge_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item surface only allows `passive` or `activation`. Staff of Striking needs a persistent weapon bonus and a separate optional rider that triggers on a melee hit with the item, spends 1-3 charges, and adds scalable extra damage to that hit. That cannot be represented honestly as either current family by itself.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 Force damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_damage_numeric
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can add to attack rolls, AC, saves, and grant extra damage instances, but it cannot express a flat bonus to the weapon's own damage rolls made with a specific item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_disenchantment_on_last_charge_roll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current destruction policy only models destruction or permanent uselessness on pool exhaustion. Staff of Striking instead remains as a mundane quarterstaff after the last-charge d20 roll.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.
